title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Appointment Charges and the Plus Base-Fee Discount
content:
The clauses below govern the base delivery fee and the stair-carry fee charged on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment, together with two rules that apply to every fee component.

## Clauses in force

**1. Base delivery fee.** The service level's base delivery fee is charged as the base delivery charge, reduced by the level's Plus base-fee discount percentage when the membership on the purchase was held at Northgate Club Plus Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership on the purchase's order date. The amount is the base delivery fee multiplied by one less that percentage, rounded to the cent; where the membership on the purchase was not held at either Plus tier on the order date, the amount is the base delivery fee.

**2. Stair carry.** Flights of stairs beyond the level's included flights are charged at the level's fee per flight each, only where the level offers stair carry and never beyond the most flights the level carries. The amount is the flights beyond those included multiplied by the fee per flight, rounded to the cent.

**3. Zero components.** A component whose amount comes to zero is not entered.

**4. Annual Reward.** Delivery and installation fees never earn Annual Reward.

## Worked figures (hypothetical fees, not a Northgate schedule)

| Case | Inputs | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Plus membership held on the order date | Base fee $80.00; Plus discount 25 percent | $80.00 multiplied by 0.75: $60.00 base delivery charge |
| Club membership on the purchase | Base fee $80.00; Plus discount 25 percent | $80.00 base delivery charge |
| Plus discount of 100 percent | Base fee $40.00 | Comes to zero: no base delivery entry |
| Stairs | 4 flights; 1 included; $30.00 a flight; up to 4 carried | 3 flights beyond, $90.00 |
| Stairs within the inclusion | 1 flight; 1 included | Comes to zero: no stair-carry entry |

The Plus test looks at the tier held on the purchase's order date, not at the tier the member holds later.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of the booking-and-fees rules are no longer in force. Each has been superseded by the current basis for the charge it concerned, and none of them governs an appointment today:

- the provision that at booking the listed charges are each entered as their own entry dated the booking date with the appointment date as the service date;
- the provision charging road miles beyond the included radius at the extended-distance fee per mile each;
- the provision charging one installation parts kit per appliance installed at the installation parts kit fee;
- the provision charging the wall-mount labor fee per television mounted;
- the provision charging haul-away of old items beyond the included haul-away items at the per-item haul-away fee each, only where haul-away is available.

The service-level figures these provisions referred to remain the figures of each service level.

superseded_clauses: road miles beyond included_radius_miles at extended_distance_fee_per_mile_usd each
At booking the following are charged, each as its own entry dated the booking date with the appointment date as service_date
